title: I will become the Pinnacle Blooms Network facility owner, Could I employ/nominate someone else to run the business?
metaTitle: Facility Management at Pinnacle Blooms Network - Empowering Leadership
description: Discover how being a Pinnacle Blooms Facility owner means exercising effective leadership and creating an exceptional team for a successful operation.
html: Indeed, as a Pinnacle Blooms Network facility owner, we recognize that you may need to delegate daily operations. You are permitted to employ or nominate a trusted individual to manage the facility. However, we expect the committed involvement of the owner in ensuring the quality and excellence of service delivery. You would also be responsible for recruiting, training, and developing your management team in alignment with Pinnacle Blooms Network's vision.
